promoterDematNotes: The difference of 50 shares of Rs. 10 each which are not held by promoter in dematerialised form is on account of Writ Petition no 1478 of 1995 filed by Rajnandini Pachasia in the High Court of Calcutta. The matter is pending in the Court and the final order is awaited. Hence, Tata Sons Private Limited has not been able to dematerialise the said 50 shares.
remarksWeb: Tata Sons Private Limited i.e. TSPL holds 31.90% of Equity Shares of the Company. TSPL, being a Core Investment Company registered with the Reserve Bank of India, is exempted from the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules 2018, as amended from time to time, on investment made by them. Other than TSPL, no shareholder holds 10% or more of paid-up Equity share capital of Company.
shareholdingPatternNotes: 1. Consequent to a Scheme of Arrangement sanctioned by the National Company Law Tribunal, 10,060 equity shares of Tata Chemicals Limited held by TMF Business Services Limited (Formerly Tata Motors Finance Limited, Promoter Group) have been transferred to Tata Motors Finance Limited (Formerly Tata Motors Finance Solutions Limited). Further, consequent to the merger approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, Tata Motors Finance Limited (formerly known as Tata Motors Finance Solutions Limited) has merged with Tata Capital Limited w.e.f. Accordingly, the Company has reported 150 shares against Tata Consumer Products Limited within the Promoter Group. 3. PT TQCert Indonesia newly incorporated Company became a part of the Promoter Group Entity of the Company w.e.f. May 26, 2026. 4. TComm Turkey Dijital zmler Limited Sirketi became a part of the Promoter Group Entity of the Company w.e.f. May 21, 2026. The Company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Communications International Pte. Ltd., which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Communications Limited. 5. TQ Cert Services LLC, Qatar became a part of the Promoter Group Entity of the Company w.e.f. May 5, 2026. 6. Smart Value Homes (New Project) LLP ceased to be a Promoter Group Entity w.e.f. October 1, 2025 as the entity is wound up and deemed liquidated. 4. Tata Capital Advisors Pte. Limited ceased to be the Promoter Group Entity w.e.f. October 31, 2025 pursuant to its amalgamation with Tata Capital Pte. Limited. 5. Tata Capital General Partners LLP, Tata Capital Healthcare General Partners LLP, Tata Opportunities General Partners LLP, Tata Capital Growth II General Partners LLP, Tata Capital Healthcare II General Partners LLP, and Tata Capital Growth III General Partners LLP are LLPs incorporated in the form of General Partners who are restricted from making any investment in the underlying portfolio company and only the respective Funds managed/controlled by them are allowed to invest in these portfolio companies. In view of the same, the Company had not included these LLPs within the scope of  Promoter Group Companies (PGC). However, as a matter of good governance, the Company has now included these LLPs in PGC list.
